english_definition: Talk, report; joking, ridicule, jesting, raillery.
Talk of the town; gossip, scandal.
Trouble, bother. False weighing or. measuring.
Breaking up and remaking; adding and deducting; prudence, sense.
Pulling and pushing backwards and forwards, or in and out, irregular oscillation, the uneasy motion or jolting of a camel, &c.
Sound of a fart. Idle foolish chattering.
Still, more, still greater, still less, still further. For good.
Talk, conversation. A prelude to music, sweet strains.
Talk, speech; improper or unpleasing talk, irritating language.
Talk, saying, mention, remembrance; reading of the Quran and reciting the praises and names of God.
Talk without end, great prolixity of tongue; a serious affair.

Successful, complete, accomplished. One whose actions are good.
Risen; sore (an eye); heavy (sea); longing, yearning (the heart).
